title: Real video thumbnails in Pins
summary: Video Pins now use real video frames instead of the generic gold placeholder.

sections.heading: Pins previews
items: Existing affected video Pins have been repaired with their generated thumbnails.
New native video Pins save generated thumbnails when processing finishes. Custom covers remain first.
Pins Studio also refreshes older ready drafts and shows the real frame before publishing.
Loading media keeps its progress bar. If a thumbnail fails, the card offers Open video.
Restart to load the latest Pins interface.
